comment: THE PARITY FIXTURE OF THE CODE-LOCATION RESOLVER (kb/Work PB5863): planted files and the locations both engines resolve in them, each with the answer the rule gives. The C# engine (SpecTraceabilityInventoryDriftTests.UnresolvedCodeLocations, the gate's resolver of the inventory's rows) writes `files` into a scratch tree; the Python engine (scripts/spec/code_location.py, the code-read importer's and planner's resolver) reads them from here. TheCodeLocationResolver_AgreesWithTheFixtureAndWithPython requires both to give `resolves` for every case, so a change to either engine that the other does not make is red. A case is added here, never in one engine's own test.
